scripts.dev: pnpm kill:ports && pnpm with-env -- turbo run dev --filter=@zomlab/web --filter=@zomlab/api
scripts.dev:web: pnpm kill:ports && pnpm with-env -- turbo run dev --filter=@zomlab/web
scripts.dev:api: pnpm kill:ports && pnpm with-env -- turbo run dev --filter=@zomlab/api
scripts.dev:legacy: pnpm run kill:ports && pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run dev --filter=@zomlab/legacy-web
scripts.dev:legacy:api: pnpm run kill:ports && pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run dev --filter=@zomlab/legacy-api
scripts.dev:standalone: pnpm run kill:ports && pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run build
scripts.build:legacy: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@zomlab/legacy-web --filter=@zomlab/legacy-api
scripts.check:all: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec biome check . && pnpm exec syncpack lint && pnpm run deps:unused && pnpm exec turbo run check-types && pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.db:generate: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:generate --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:migrate --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:push: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:push --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:deploy: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:deploy --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:studio: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:studio --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.deps:unused: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec knip
scripts.clean: pnpm exec rimraf node_modules .turbo dist test-results generated apps/*/{node_modules,.turbo,dist,generated,.output,.wrangler,storybook-static} packages/*/{node_modules,.turbo,dist,generated,.output,.wrangler,storybook-static}
